title: Updates on Tick Size for Multiple USDⓈ-M Perpetual Futures Contracts (2025-04-17)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, In order to increase market liquidity and improve users’ trading experience, Binance will adjust the tick size (i.e., the minimum change in the unit price) of the below USDⓈ-M Perpetual Futures Contracts at  2025-04-17 06:00 (UTC) . The adjustment will  not  impact USDⓈ-M Futures trading operations.  Tick size via API will also change. API users may use  GET /fapi/v1/exchangeInfo  to find the latest tick size of USDⓈ-M Perpetual Futures Contracts. For further details and updates, please refer to our full  API Changelog . The tick size update will  not  affect existing orders. After the tick size is updated, orders placed before the update will still be matched with the original tick size.
